take: Tampa Bay announced it activated center Yanni Gourde from injured reserve. He has played two games this season, scoring one goal on 0.39 expected goals (a measure of the quality of his chances), and the Lightning created 43% of the 5-on-5 expected goals while he was on the ice, about 13 points worse than when he sat. TBL is 12-4-2 and holds 55% of expected goals overall. Gourde slots back into a first-line role at 15:19 a night, which pushes Brandon Hagel (18:44 a night) back down the list for those minutes.
